title: Vitest
description: A blazing fast Vite-native unit test framework.

data.text: Vitest is a unit test framework designed for Vite. It offers Jest-compatible APIs while leveraging Vite's fast dev server and native ESM support, resulting in faster test execution and hot reloading.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Vitest as a dev dependency.
data.code:
npm install --save-dev vitest
# or
yarn add --dev vitest

data.title: Basic Test
Vite Integration
data.text: Vitest works seamlessly with Vite, sharing the same config and plugin ecosystem for faster setup and execution.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Vitest is optimized for Vite projects
Watch mode and HMR make TDD fast
data.takeaway: Vitest is the modern choice for testing Vite-powered JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
